request.name: Submit campaign appeal for manual review

description.content: Submits an appeal for rejected native campaigns in TELNYX_FAILED or MNO_REJECTED status. The appeal is recorded for manual compliance team review and the campaign status is reset to TCR_ACCEPTED. Note: Appeal forwarding is handled manually to allow proper review before incurring upstream charges.
